brief:
Militant Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the West Bank on Thursday, according to Al-Monitor. The destruction followed settler attacks that prevented the family from returning to their residences in defiance of an earlier directive.

The incident marks the latest in a series of settler attacks against Palestinian property in the occupied territory.

title: Israeli settlers destroy Palestinian homes in West Bank
